No frame lines, text, labels, names, scene, separate object, ground shadow, aura, slash, dust or particle effects. Whole character/weapon fits inside every frame. No cut-off limbs or detached limbs.

provenance.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art northern underworld game sprite.
Input1 is ONLY a project-owned style reference: use its pixel treatment, dark contours, upper-left illumination, readable clusters. Do not reproduce reference figures, scenes or labels.
Subject: An irregular low oval puddle of thick dark-green poison viewed overhead, clear olive-green rim and deep ink-green center. Four looping phases of a few round bubbles inflating, popping, reforming, fixed puddle outline and size. No potion bottle, smoke cloud, floating skulls or ground scene. Opaque solid pixels with transparent exterior.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR frames in a2by2 grid of equal 96x48 logical cells, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. 
Use cold gray, charcoal, bone ivory, muted moss-green and dark purple, restrained phosphor turquoise accents; warm gold-white only for the young soul and russet only for squirrel. Same visual language as reference game sprites. True low-resolution pixelart at stated logical resolution, not tiny painted microdetails. Sharp square pixel clusters, no dithering, no smooth gradients, max32-48colors. Fixed camera, common exact scale and center across phases.
Genuine transparent RGBA background, binary opaque artwork, at leastTWOlogicalpixels empty on every side of each cell. No anti-aliased transparent fringes, no checkerboard drawn in, no frame borders, names, letters, labels, signature, text, watermark, foreground ground shadows or background scene. Entire object visible, nothing cut off.

Subject: A stout battered dark-iron chain stake driven vertically into a compact rock foot, thick riveted collar and large iron ring, one length of heavy broken chain draped toward right side. Gnarled coarse iron with restrained gray-green patina, northern underworld game prop, not a ship anchor. No ground scene.
Layout: ONE standalone sprite, target logical canvas 64x96. 
Use cold gray, charcoal, bone ivory, muted moss-green and dark purple, restrained phosphor turquoise accents; warm gold-white only for the young soul and russet only for squirrel. Same visual language as reference game sprites. True low-resolution pixelart at stated logical resolution, not tiny painted microdetails. Sharp square pixel clusters, no dithering, no smooth gradients, max32-48colors. 
Genuine transparent RGBA background, binary opaque artwork, at leastTWOlogicalpixels empty on every side of each cell. No anti-aliased transparent fringes, no checkerboard drawn in, no frame borders, names, letters, labels, signature, text, watermark, foreground ground shadows or background scene. Entire object visible, nothing cut off.
